title: Beyond paper counts: Code and supporting data
description: Research code, frozen aggregate data, preserved country-level API responses, public model inputs with direct identifiers removed, calibration coordinates, and publication assets for Beyond Paper Counts. Model refits start from preserved distances. Missing work-level OpenAlex inputs and unrecorded SPECTER2 revisions limit upstream reproduction. Code is MIT; new numeric exports are CC0 1.0; upstream data retain their terms. See README for verification and execution commands.
